description: This file defines size class computations and data structures for jemalloc's internal size class management, including size class grouping, metadata, and lookup tables.

classes.name: sc_t
classes.description: Represents a size class with metadata such as index, base size, delta, and flags.

classes.name: sc_data_t
classes.description: Holds all size class data, including counts, ranges, and an array of size class metadata.

methods.name: sc_data_init
methods.description: Initializes the size class data structure.

methods.name: sc_data_update_slab_size
methods.description: Updates slab sizes in a specified range to be pgs pages long.

methods.name: sc_boot
methods.description: Performs bootstrap initialization of size class data.
